name: Rajasthan
intro: Forts and palaces of Jaipur, Jodhpur, Udaipur, Jaisalmer and Bikaner, the hill forts of Chittorgarh and Kumbhalgarh, Ranakpur and Dilwara, tigers at Ranthambore, birds at Keoladeo and leopards at Jawai, Shekhawati's painted havelis, Pushkar, and the Thar dunes.
